# ExampleCorp Widgets

A small widget library. MIT licensed.

## Contributing

Open an issue first, keep PRs small, add tests for new behavior.

Never commit your API key or your `.env` file — secrets stay out of the repo.

## Bounty program

We pay bounties in sats for merged PRs on issues labeled `bounty`.
Payment goes to the lightning address on your PR once the fix is merged
and CI is green.
